title: Static Spread Radiating-Neck-Frill Long-Tail Lizard
description: One newly authored whole static stylised frilled lizard. A low pointed head rises from a narrow neck into one continuous elongated torso and very long gently side-curved tapering tail. One whole thick open-centred radiating pleated neck membrane surrounds the actual neck, flaring into an uneven broad fan; both front and back surfaces and the entire rim are real geometry. Four complete outward bent limbs end in long splayed finite three-pronged feet, with small lateral eyes. Not a copied coiled-tail chameleon with a decorative disc, nor extracted axolotl gill fans. One entire animal model zero scenes. Deliberately simplified opaque low-poly appearance; no exact species, membrane anatomy, threat display, locomotion, rigging or animation claim.
